lines.en: label otohaspecial15p2:
scene otohapostcafe1
After a long and mostly awkward walk, the three of us make it to the cafe to find things significantly busier than I have ever seen before.
lines.zh: 走了一段漫长而多半很尴尬的路之后，我们三个到了咖啡厅，发现这里比我以往见过的任何时候都热闹得多。

lines.en: What’s even worse is that Molly appears to be the only person working.
lines.zh: 更糟的是，Molly 似乎是唯一一个在干活的人。

lines.en: I’ll give you a few seconds to think about that.
lines.zh: 我给你几秒钟想想这意味着什么。

lines.en: Yeah. I know.
lines.zh: 是啊。我知道。

lines.en: : Uhh...okay! So, the line starts at the left and-
lines.zh: : 呃……好的！那么，队伍从左边开始排——

lines.en: : What’s a caramel macchiato?
lines.zh: : 焦糖玛奇朵是什么？

lines.en: : Well, it’s an espresso beverage with-
lines.zh: : 嗯，那是一种浓缩咖啡饮品，加了——

lines.en: : This line is taking forever. I want to speak to the manager.
lines.zh: : 这队伍排得没完没了。我要找经理。

lines.en: : Oh man. I’ve seen this once before. Tourist bus.
lines.zh: : 哦老天。这场景我见过一次。旅游大巴。

lines.en: : Good thing Molly’s working. She’s the only person on staff who even speaks English.
lines.zh: : 还好是 Molly 在上班。她是员工里唯一会说英语的人。

lines.en: : Oh, right. Sometimes I forget that we’ve been speaking in Japanese this whole time.
lines.zh: : 哦对。我有时候会忘记，我们一直以来其实都在说日语。

lines.en: : Uhh...I’m actually the only person working right now. But if you’ll just be patient-
lines.zh: : 呃……我现在真的是唯一一个在干活的人。不过只要你们稍等一下——

lines.en: : Did you just tell my wife to be patient?! How dare you! Now I would like to speak to the manager as well!
lines.zh: : 你刚才是在叫我太太耐心点吗？！你竟敢！现在我也要见经理！

lines.en: : Do you people even listen? I’m trying-
lines.zh: : 你们这些人到底听不听人说话？我在试着——

lines.en: : You people?! What is that supposed to mean?! The racism in this country is absurd!
lines.zh: : 你们这些人？！你这话什么意思？！这个国家的种族主义简直荒唐！

lines.en: : I’m not even Japanese! I’m European, just like you!
lines.zh: : 我根本不是日本人！我跟你们一样是欧洲人！

lines.en: : Why do we even have tourists? The city’s been closed for years.
lines.zh: : 我们怎么还会有游客？这座城市都封了好几年了。

lines.en: : They all live in one giant hotel building in the Entertainment District and only leave a few times per year. Always in packs.
lines.zh: : 他们都住在娱乐区一栋巨大的酒店楼里，一年只出来几次。而且总是成群结队。

lines.en: : Is this going to be a new subplot?
lines.zh: : 这要变成一条新的支线了吗？

lines.en: : Can Molly really handle all of those people by herself?
lines.zh: : Molly 真能一个人应付得了这么多人吗？

lines.en: : Molly can barely handle one customer by herself, let alone an entire bus worth. But hey, at least they’re speaking her native tongue.
lines.zh: : Molly 一个人连一个客人都勉强，更别说一整车的量了。不过话说回来，至少他们在说她的母语。

lines.en: : Okay! Everybody line up! I have no idea who to help first if you’re gonna come at me like this is some sort of gauntlet!
lines.zh: : 好了！大家排好队！你们要是像闯关一样一拥而上，我根本不知道该先帮谁！

lines.en: : Hah...
: The temperature in here is too high! Can we turn it down?
lines.zh: : 这里温度太高了！能调低点吗？

lines.en: : My son wants to watch TV!
lines.zh: : 我儿子想看电视！

lines.en: : I’m allergic to whipped cream!
lines.zh: : 我对鲜奶油过敏！

lines.en: : No, no, and...don’t get it then? Uhh...let’s see...
lines.zh: : 不行，不行，还有……那就别加？呃……让我想想……

lines.en: scene otohapostcafe2
: Guys, I’m sorry. I know we came over here to cool things down and show Otoha that she {i}doesn’t{/i} have to work until her body gives out...but I’ve gotta help Molly.
lines.zh: : 各位，抱歉。我知道我们来这儿是为了放松一下，也让 Otoha 明白她{i}不必{/i}工作到身体垮掉……但我得去帮 Molly。

lines.en: : Do you know enough English {i}to{/i} help?
lines.zh: : 你的英语够用来{i}帮忙{/i}吗？

lines.en: : Not really, but I’ll figure something out. I can’t just leave her hanging like this.
lines.zh: : 不太够，不过我会想办法的。我不能就这么把她晾在那儿。

lines.en: scene otohapostcafe3
: Is that okay? I’ll try and be quick. I promise.
lines.zh: : 可以吗？我会尽量快点。我保证。

lines.en: : It’s fine. I’ve been alone with Sensei before and I’m somehow still alive.
lines.zh: : 没关系。我以前也跟 Sensei 单独待过，不知怎么的还活着。

lines.en: : Plus, I doubt he’ll try anything weird in a cafe full of white people. They {i}love{/i} calling the police.
lines.zh: : 再说，在一屋子白人的咖啡厅里，我怀疑他也不敢搞什么奇怪的名堂。他们{i}最爱{/i}报警了。

lines.en: : Okay. Come get me if you need me, alright?
lines.zh: : 好。需要我的话就来找我，好吗？

lines.en: : Are we just going to ignore Otoha’s casual racism right there?
lines.zh: : 我们就这么无视 Otoha 刚才那随口一说的种族主义吗？

lines.en: scene otohapostcafe4
: Otoha, do you promise you’ll be nice to the white people while I’m gone?
lines.zh: : Otoha，你保证我不在的时候会对白人友善点吗？

lines.en: : As long as Sensei promises to not do anything that will make them call the police.
lines.zh: : 只要 Sensei 保证不做任何会让他们报警的事。

lines.en: : There it is again. You can’t keep getting away with this.
lines.zh: : 又来了。你不能一直这么蒙混过关。

lines.en: : {i}Both{/i} of you be good. I have to go save Molly’s life.
lines.zh: : 你们{i}两个{/i}都给我老实点。我得去救 Molly 的命了。

lines.en: scene black
Otoha (Who may or may not be mildly racist?) and I make our way through the labyrinth of Europeans to an unoccupied table not far from the end of the line.
lines.zh: 我，还有 Otoha（她也许有点种族主义，也许没有），穿过这片欧洲人组成的迷宫，走到离队尾不远的一张空桌旁。

lines.en: Ideally, I would have liked sitting a little further away as it’s excruciatingly loud where we are, but it seems that every other table has yet to be cleaned —likely on account of the whole one employee thing.
lines.zh: 理想情况下我本想坐得再远一点，因为我们这儿吵得要命，可看起来其他桌子都还没收拾——大概就是那个「只有一个员工」的问题。

lines.en: But hey, if anyone can get Molly out of this rut, it’s Rin.
lines.zh: 不过话说回来，如果有人能把 Molly 从这个困境里捞出来，那就是 Rin 了。

lines.en: Because even if she doesn’t speak the same language as all of the customers in the store right now, she {i}does{/i} know how to make a beverage.
lines.zh: 因为就算她跟现在店里所有客人说的不是同一种语言，她{i}确实{/i}知道怎么做饮品。

lines.en: It just...might not be the beverage any of those customers actually order.
lines.zh: 只是……做出来的可能不是任何一位客人真正点的那杯。

lines.en: scene otohapostcafe5
: I can’t tell if I like this new look or not.
lines.zh: : 我说不上来自己喜不喜欢你这个新造型。

lines.en: : Are you physically attracted to girls who look like they just crawled out of the sewer?
lines.zh: : 你对那种看起来刚从下水道里爬出来的女孩有性趣吗？

lines.en: : Maybe?
lines.zh: : 也许吧？

lines.en: : Then you probably like this new look.
lines.zh: : 那你大概会喜欢这个新造型。

lines.en: scene otohapostcafe6
: It’s not staying, though. I’ll be going back to normal in the morning.
lines.zh: : 不过这造型留不久。明天早上我就恢复正常了。

lines.en: : How come?
lines.zh: : 怎么讲？

lines.en: scene otohapostcafe7
: Uhh...because this is the result of neglecting my personal health and hygiene for an entire weekend and is not indicative of a healthy lifestyle?
lines.zh: : 呃……因为这是整整一个周末不管自己的健康和个人卫生换来的结果，并不能代表健康的生活方式？

lines.en: : Also, having my bangs drop down in front of my eyes obscures my vision. I need to be able to see so I don’t...accidentally kiss the wrong girl or something.
lines.zh: : 而且刘海垂下来挡在眼前会挡住视线。我得看得见才行，免得……不小心亲错女孩什么的。

lines.en: : Or me.
lines.zh: : 或者亲错我。

lines.en: scene otohapostcafe8
: Honestly, that would probably be more forgivable.
lines.zh: : 说实话，那大概还更容易被原谅。

lines.en: : Cool, come here while she’s not looking.
lines.zh: : 好极了，趁她没看这边过来一下。

lines.en: scene otohapostcafe9
: Dude, come on. Not the time.
lines.zh: : 老兄，拜托。不是时候。

lines.en: : I can’t think of a better time. I’ve barely seen you at all ever since the Dorm Wars ended. Though, that is for reasons I can’t really bring up without sounding clinically insane.
lines.zh: : 我想不出更好的时机了。宿舍大战结束之后，我几乎就没怎么见过你。不过这其中的原因，我要是说了，听起来准像个临床疯子。

lines.en: : Acknowledging the fact that I’ve been a complete dick to you for months wouldn’t make you sound clinically insane. It would make {i}me{/i} sound like a bitch, though.
lines.zh: : 承认我这几个月来一直对你混蛋透顶，并不会让你听起来像临床疯子。倒是会让{i}我{/i}听起来像个泼妇。

lines.en: : But that’s fine because I’m starting to realize that’s precisely what I am.
lines.zh: : 不过没关系，因为我开始意识到，我本来就是这样。

lines.en: : Well, you did just slap your biggest fan in the entire world across the face with absolutely no consequences whatsoever.
lines.zh: : 嗯，你刚刚才扇了全世界最喜欢你的人一巴掌，而且完全没有任何后果。

lines.en: : And you did throw a bit of a tantrum after Rin lost her trivia competition. Which is significantly more forgivable, but...still not a good look for you.
lines.zh: : 还有 Rin 输了问答比赛之后你也发了一通脾气。这个倒是容易原谅得多，不过……对你形象还是不好。

lines.en: : And you {i}did{/i} skip out on the Christmas party for-
lines.zh: : 而且你{i}确实{/i}没去圣诞派对，因为——

lines.en: scene otohapostcafe10
: I get it, okay? You don’t have to go and name every single thing.
lines.zh: : 我明白了，好吗？你不用把每件都点出来。

lines.en: : I’m in...this weird headspace lately that I’ve been having a lot of trouble pulling myself out of and I’ve been...kind of taking that out on the people who are around me.
lines.zh: : 我最近陷在……一种很奇怪的精神状态里，怎么都爬不出来，而且我还……一直拿身边的人撒气。

lines.en: scene otohapostcafe11
: I really {i}am{/i} sorry, though. I {i}have{/i} been wanting to say that, I’ve just had no idea how to approach you about it.
lines.zh: : 不过我真的{i}很{/i}抱歉。我{i}一直{/i}都想跟你说这句，只是不知道该怎么开口。

lines.en: : I want shit to go back to normal. Or...at least whatever “normal” was for us since you’ve always been kind of a huge creep. Who has also seen my girlfriend’s boobs.
lines.zh: : 我想让一切回到正常。或者……至少回到属于我们的那种“正常”——毕竟你一直都是个超级变态。而且还看过我女朋友的胸。

lines.en: : They’re really nice. I won’t lie to you.
lines.zh: : 那对胸真的很棒。我不骗你。

lines.en: scene otohapostcafe12
: Right? They’re so much bigger than they look when she has her clothes on.
lines.zh: : 对吧？她穿上衣服的时候，看着可比实际小多了。

lines.en: : Oh, good. I didn’t realize you two had actually made it that far yet.
lines.zh: : 哦，不错。我都没意识到你们俩已经进展到那一步了。

lines.en: scene otohapostcafe13
: There...have been pictures exchanged. As far as real life goes, though-
lines.zh: : 照片……是互发过了。至于现实里嘛——

lines.en: scene otohapostcafe14
: Wait, why am I telling you this?! You’re my teacher! Stop me next time I go too far!
lines.zh: : 等等，我为什么要跟你说这些？！你是我老师！下次我说过头了记得拦住我！

lines.en: : I’m not just your teacher, Otoha. I’m your {i}friend.{/i}
lines.zh: : 我不只是你的老师，Otoha。我是你的{i}朋友{/i}。

lines.en: scene otohapostcafe15
: Eww...gross.
lines.zh: : 呕……恶心。

lines.en: : Isn’t that kind of what I was at the peak of our “normal,” though?
lines.zh: : 可我们“正常”的时候最要好的那阵子，我不就是这种角色吗？

lines.en: : That’s what you want to go back to, right?
lines.zh: : 你想回到的就是那个状态，对吧？

lines.en: scene otohapostcafe16
: I...guess. I don’t know. It just feels like things kind of shifted with us around Halloween and...
lines.zh: : 我……大概吧。我不知道。只是感觉我们之间的关系在万圣节前后变了，然后……

lines.en: : It pains me to admit this, but I’m kind of...jealous of you.
lines.zh: : 承认这个挺痛苦的，但我有点……嫉妒你。

lines.en: : Jealous? Of {i}me?{/i} Why?
lines.zh: : 嫉妒？嫉妒{i}我{/i}？为什么？

lines.en: : You’re a hot, talented prodigy with a girlfriend who would do anything for you, a vocal coach who thinks you’re going to be a star, and attentive parents. Why would you be jealous of {i}me?{/i}
lines.zh: : 你又辣又有才华，是个天才，有个愿意为你做任何事的女朋友，有个觉得你会成为巨星的声乐老师，还有关心你的父母。你有什么好嫉妒{i}我{/i}的？

lines.en: : Because...
lines.zh: : 因为……

lines.en: : Because of Rin.
lines.zh: : 因为 Rin。

lines.en: : You guys have this kind of chemistry that I can’t really figure out how to replicate. I don’t know.
lines.zh: : 你们之间有那种默契，我怎么都搞不明白该怎么复制。我也不知道。

lines.en: : Maybe it’s because we weren’t ever really {i}friends{/i} the way you guys were since she’s been pining after me from the get-go.
lines.zh: : 也许是因为我们从一开始就没有真正像你们那样当过{i}朋友{/i}——她从一开始就一直在暗恋我。

lines.en: : It’s not just with you either. I’ve been jealous of everyone that comes near her. Even Futaba sometimes, who is literally zero percent lesbian and not a threat at all.
lines.zh: : 也不只是你。我对每个靠近她的人都会嫉妒。有时候连 Futaba 也是——她可是百分之零的蕾丝边，一点威胁都没有。

lines.en: : I don’t think Rin is going to leave you for anyone else if that’s what you’re worried about, Otoha.
lines.zh: : 如果你担心的是这个，我觉得 Rin 不会为了别人离开你，Otoha。

lines.en: : That’s the worst part. You’re probably {i}right.{/i} I just can’t seem to get a handle on that and keep lashing out at everyone regardless.
lines.zh: : 这才是最糟的。你大概{i}是对的{/i}。可我就是没办法消化这一点，还是忍不住对所有人乱发脾气。

lines.en: : Like, Chika fucking hates me now because she can see through that. But instead of appreciating her for caring that much about Rin, I automatically interpret it as “Chika wants to fuck her.”
lines.zh: : 比如说，Chika 现在恨死我了，因为她把这看得一清二楚。可我没有去感激她那么关心 Rin，反而自动把它解读成“Chika 想上她”。

lines.en: : And {i}you{/i} would hate me as well if you weren’t waiting to pick me up on the rebound or something because I’ve been nothing but cold to you for months.
lines.zh: : 而{i}你{/i}本来也该恨我的，除非你是在等着我分手后趁虚而入什么的——毕竟这几个月来我对你只有冷淡。

lines.en: : That is {i}why{/i} I like you.
lines.zh: : 那{i}正是{/i}我喜欢你的原因。

lines.en: scene otohapostcafe17
: What?
lines.zh: : 什么？

lines.en: : You and Yumi are pretty much the only girls in the class who see through all of the shit I do while not being afraid to point out how wrong all of it is.
lines.zh: : 你和 Yumi 大概是班上唯二两个能看穿我做的那些破事、又不怕直说这一切有多错的女孩。

lines.en: : I’m not going to hate you for seeing me as who I really am.
lines.zh: : 我不会因为你把我看穿了就恨你。

lines.en: : In fact, I wouldn’t hate you even if you went around and told everyone I’m having sex with Chika.
lines.zh: : 事实上，就算你跑去跟所有人说我和 Chika 在睡觉，我也不会恨你。

lines.en: scene otohapostcafe18
: I know you know. Rin told me she accidentally spilled the details. You don’t have to play dumb. We can talk about it.
lines.zh: : 我知道你知道。Rin 跟我说她不小心把细节说漏了。你不用装傻。我们可以谈。

lines.en: scene otohapostcafe19
: Gotcha...
lines.zh: : 知道了……

lines.en: : Does it disgust you?
lines.zh: : 你觉得恶心吗？

lines.en: : I need to be careful to not say the wrong thing right now because it will turn what was supposed to be an apology into...something else I’d have to apologize for.
lines.zh: : 我现在得小心别说错话，不然本来该是道歉的话，就会变成……另一件我还得再道歉的事。

lines.en: : We’ve fucked probably a hundred times by now. And I have no intention of stopping — even if she’s half my age and half my size.
lines.zh: : 到现在我们大概已经上过一百次床了。而且我一点停下来的意思都没有——哪怕她的年龄是我的一半，个头也是我的一半。

lines.en: : {i}Does that disgust you?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}这让你恶心吗？{/i}

lines.en: : Do you love her?
lines.zh: : 你爱她吗？

lines.en: : Does it matter?
lines.zh: : 这重要吗？

lines.en: scene otohapostcafe20
: {i}What are you doing, man? {/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你在干什么啊，老兄？{/i}

lines.en: : If you know it’s wrong, why don’t you stop?
lines.zh: : 如果你知道这是错的，为什么不停下来？

lines.en: : Dragging innocent girls down with you isn’t going to make you feel good at the end of the day. It’s just going to hurt them as well.
lines.zh: : 把无辜的女孩一起拖下水，到头来也不会让你好受。只会让她们也受伤。

lines.en: : And you want to protect Rin from that...don’t you?
lines.zh: : 而你想保护 Rin 不受这种伤害……对吧？

lines.en: : I just don’t understand, Sensei. It’s not abnormal for people to {i}feel{/i} immoral shit like that from time to time, but once you start acting on those feelings...can you ever really be forgiven?
lines.zh: : 我只是不明白，Sensei。人偶尔{i}产生{/i}那种不道德的念头并不算反常，可一旦你开始照着那些感觉去做……还能真的被原谅吗？

lines.en: : What do you think?
lines.zh: : 你觉得呢？

lines.en: : I think you can do better than this.
lines.zh: : 我觉得你能做得比这更好。

lines.en: : In fact, I {i}know{/i} you can do better than this.
lines.zh: : 事实上，我{i}知道{/i}你能做得比这更好。

lines.en: scene otohapostcafe21
: You’re...back together with Niki, aren’t you? Why don’t you just stay with her?
lines.zh: : 你……跟 Niki 复合了，对吧？你为什么不就留在她身边？

lines.en: : How did-
lines.zh: : 你怎么——

lines.en: : Because she’s happy. Like {i}really{/i} happy.
lines.zh: : 因为她很幸福。{i}真的{/i}很幸福。

lines.en: : She hasn’t said anything about it to me because why would she? But I can hear it in her voice.
lines.zh: : 她什么都没跟我说过，她干嘛要跟我说呢？但我能从她的声音里听出来。

lines.en: : Niki and I...
lines.zh: : Niki 和我……

lines.en: : It’s complicated.
lines.zh: : 很复杂。

lines.en: scene otohapostcafe22
: {i}It’s only complicated because you keep running around and fucking teenage girls! It doesn’t have to be that way!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}会复杂，只是因为你到处乱跑、跟女高中生上床！本来不必是这样的！{/i}

lines.en: : Chika’s the only one I know of, but who’s to say there’s not more?
lines.zh: : Chika 是我唯一知道的一个，可谁说得准没有更多？

lines.en: : There are.
: Why are you not trying to get a handle on this when it’s well within your power to do that? I don’t get it.
lines.zh: : 你明明有能力控制住，为什么不试着去控制？我不明白。

lines.en: : You sound just like her sometimes, you know.
lines.zh: : 你有时候说话跟她一模一样，你知道吗。

lines.en: : Who?
: Niki.
lines.zh: : Niki。

lines.en: scene otohapostcafe23
: Oh, great. Just what I needed to hear.
lines.zh: : 哦，真好。这正是我想听的。

lines.en: : I mean it. I had a similar conversation with her recently and it all boiled down to the fact that I’m just...probably beyond saving at this point.
lines.zh: : 我是认真的。我最近跟她谈过一次类似的，最后归结起来就是：我大概……已经没救了。

lines.en: : You’re not beyond it, you don’t {i}want{/i} to be saved. Which is...really fucking annoying.
lines.zh: : 你不是没救，你是{i}不想{/i}被救。这才……他妈的让人火大。

lines.en: : There are tons of us out there who are struggling to keep the shitty parts of ourselves locked away and you’re just running around and flashing those parts of yourself for the whole world to see.
lines.zh: : 外面有无数人正拼命把自己身上那些糟糕的部分锁起来，而你却到处乱跑，把那些部分掏出来给全世界看。

lines.en: : That’s not the example you need to be setting.
lines.zh: : 你不该树立这种榜样。

lines.en: : Am I a bad influence on you, Otoha?
lines.zh: : 我对你是个坏影响吗，Otoha？

lines.en: scene otohapostcafe24
: I think...you {i}are.{/i}
lines.zh: : 我觉得……你{i}是{/i}。

lines.en: : I can keep you out better than the other girls, sure- but when you’re around someone every single day, parts of that person are going to naturally start rubbing off on you after a while.
lines.zh: : 我确实比别的女孩更能把你挡在外面——但你天天跟一个人待在一起，时间一长，那个人的某些部分自然会沾到你身上。

lines.en: : Sensei, I want things to go back to normal with us...I want to be able to laugh and call you a creep the next time you barge into my room because I {i}know{/i} my girlfriend loves you. And I want to as well.
lines.zh: : Sensei，我想让我们回到正常……我想下次你闯进我房间的时候，我能笑着骂你变态，因为我{i}知道{/i}我女朋友爱你。而且我也想爱你。

lines.en: : But I’m afraid of what will happen to me if you stay the way you are.
lines.zh: : 可我害怕，如果你一直是现在这个样子，我会变成什么样。

lines.en: : You don’t think...your freakout thing today was because of {i}me,{/i} do-
lines.zh: : 你不会觉得……你今天那场崩溃是{i}我{/i}造成的吧——

lines.en: scene otohapostcafe25
: No! No, no, no! That was a totally different thing! That’s more of the Otoha who can’t get her thoughts in order right now!
lines.zh: : 不！不不不！那完全是另一回事！那更像是我现在理不清思绪的那一面！

lines.en: : But there’s an Otoha somewhere underneath that who {i}isn’t{/i} drowning yet...and she needs someone to throw her a lifejacket instead of holding her head underwater.
lines.zh: : 但在那底下还有另一个 Otoha，她还没{i}溺水{/i}……而她需要有人扔给她一件救生衣，而不是把她的头按在水里。

lines.en: : {i}I need help.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我需要帮助。{/i}

lines.en: : I really need help...
lines.zh: : 我真的需要帮助……

lines.en: : With...what? What do you need?
lines.zh: : 帮……什么？你需要什么？

lines.en: scene otohapostcafe26
: Uhh...

lines.zh: : 那么……

lines.en: : I know you already said you wouldn’t care if I went around telling everyone about you and Chika, but...I’m gonna pretend you {i}didn’t{/i} say that to try and like...use it as a bargaining chip for a sec?
lines.zh: : 我知道你说过，就算我到处去说你和 Chika 的事你也不在乎，不过……我要假装你{i}没{/i}说过那句话，好把它当作……嗯，当个谈判筹码用一下？

lines.en: : Uhh...okay?
lines.zh: : 呃……行吧？

lines.en: : So, uhh...
lines.zh: : 那么，呃……

lines.en: : You remember how I didn’t come to the Christmas party?
lines.zh: : 你还记得我没去圣诞派对的事吧？

lines.en: : I do. And I also remember how torn up Rin was the whole time.
lines.zh: : 记得。我也记得 Rin 整晚有多难过。

lines.en: : Yeah, well...
lines.zh: : 是啊，那个……

lines.en: : There was a good reason for that. And by “good” I mean bad. There was a {i}bad{/i} reason.
lines.zh: : 那是有原因的。而我说的好理由，其实是坏理由。那是个{i}坏{/i}理由。

lines.en: : You, see...
lines.zh: : 你看……

lines.en: : Uhh...
: While you guys were off having fun and doing...holiday stuff, I was-
lines.zh: : 你们在别处玩得开心、做着……过节的事的时候，我在——

lines.en: scene otohapostcafe27
: Ah!
: Hi! We’re almost done. My English sucks. I just wanted to take a five second break to tell you how much I miss you and appreciate your existence on this planet.
lines.zh: : 嗨！我们快忙完了。我英语烂透了。我只是想抽五秒钟休息一下，告诉你我有多想你，以及你存在于这个星球上让我有多感激。

lines.en: : Also, I love you. And I know you don’t want to say it back yet and that’s totally cool. Also, you’re hot.
lines.zh: : 还有，我爱你。我知道你现在还不想说回来，那完全没关系。还有，你很辣。

lines.en: : Anyway, bye.
lines.zh: : 总之，拜。

lines.en: scene otohapostcafe28
: Love you too, Dad. You don’t have to say it back either.
lines.zh: : 也爱你，老爸。你也不用说回来。

lines.en: scene otohapostcafe29
Rin walks back up to the counter and I’m suddenly left with a significantly quieter Otoha now that our conversation has been interrupted.
lines.zh: Rin 走回柜台，我们的对话被打断之后，我突然面对着一个安静得多的 Otoha。

lines.en: : Hah...
: What were you saying just now?
lines.zh: : 你刚才说到哪儿了？

lines.en: : About what happened on Christmas...
lines.zh: : 关于圣诞节那天发生的事……

lines.en: scene otohapostcafe30
: It doesn’t matter.
lines.zh: : 不重要了。

lines.en: : Just...stop being such a weirdo all the time, okay?
lines.zh: : 只是……别老是这么神经兮兮的，好吗？

lines.en: : Let’s be...{i}friends.{/i}
lines.zh: : 我们……{i}做朋友{/i}吧。

lines.en: : I have to get along with you if she does. And it’s not like I think you’re the worst or anything as-is.
lines.zh: : 她跟你关系好，我就也得跟你好好相处。再说我又没觉得你是最差劲的那种人。

lines.en: : Otoha-
lines.zh: : Otoha——

lines.en: : I can’t handle any more today.
lines.zh: : 我今天承受不了更多了。

lines.en: : Please leave it at that.
lines.zh: : 请就这样吧。

lines.en: scene black
I leave it at that...
lines.zh: 我就此打住……

lines.en: And the day comes to an end without me ever discovering what it is she has to hide from me.
lines.zh: 这一天就这么结束，而我始终没能发现她究竟要对我隐瞒什么。
